title: Antioxidant and moisturizing active exopolysaccharide produced by beauveria bassiana T2-2 and application thereof
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of microorganisms, especially to an antioxidant and moisturizing active exopolysaccharide produced by beauveria bassiana T2-2 and application thereof. Thebeauveria bassiana T2-2 has the preservation number of CCTCC NO: M2019145; the exopolysaccharide has high oxidation resistance and moisture retention and thus canb e applied to the fields of cosmeticsand health products; and cells can be protected from being attacked by the free radical and aging can be prevented. Moreover, the price is low; and the production is safe. When the exopolysaccharideproduced by beauveria bassiana T2-2 is applied to the cosmetics, the skin can be kept moist, elastic, soft and smooth; the affinity with the skin is good; the exopolysaccharide is pure and thus is a good cosmetic skin care product additive component.
